title: Usage
description: Approval cases and revisions of your company per month – counted from events and reproducible from the raw data at any time.
recomputeDone: Counters recomputed from the raw data

recomputeConfirm.title: Recompute counters?
recomputeConfirm.description: The counters are recalculated from the stored revisions and replace the continuously updated values. The result must match the previous values.

recomputeHint: Reproducible counting: “Recompute” derives all values from the revisions.
definition: An approval case counts once in the month of its first submission (revision 1) – for the submitting supplier and for the receiving customer. Further revisions are shown separately; legacy cases do not count.
